inputs.prompt: Edit the supplied EVA Seed-33 synthetic app capture as a bounded visual reference for TWO corrections only. Preserve the exact fixed camera, Paris street, light-beaded/halftone/strand rendering style, deep umber ground, pale bone sky, warm coral/ochre/bone tile colors, foreground chair on the LEFT and table/cup arrangement. Do NOT turn this into a photograph or change the scene architecture. First correction: the COLORED FILLED TILES themselves are corrupted matter, not intact rectangles with marks drawn around them. Show irregular horizontal slices breaking apart, stretched rows, offset color blocks, missing narrow bands and displaced reassembled fragments within and immediately around their existing anchored regions. Keep the same overall tile groups; no drifting whole rectangles and no new large scene-covering blocks. Existing delicate crossed tracking rectangles remain subordinate. Second correction: the adult woman in the coat is walking slowly AWAY from the camera toward the LEFT side of the foreground chair. Show a believable rear three-quarter view facing upper-left, not a face pointed at the viewer, not a mirrored front-facing sprite. Clearly readable articulated shoulders, elbows, hips, knees, ankles and two distinct feet: one foot planted with weight over it, the other leg swinging through with a bent knee and lifted heel, opposing natural arm swing, restrained torso lean. Feet contact the street plane. Keep their visual material as bone-light stipple/halftone strands, not solid photorealistic skin or a cartoon. Their trajectory must recede and become smaller toward scene-left, never approach/enlarge toward the user. Show one coherent full-scene frame, not a collage, not duplicated people, no arrows, labels, UI or text. This is a development reference for a live articulated code rig and live tile fragmentation, not runtime video playback.

inputs.prompt: Animate this exact Seed-33 stippled light-strand Paris scene with a LOCKED camera. Preserve the street, foreground chair on the LEFT, table/cup, warm palette and halftone light material. Two live actions only. ONE: the rear-facing adult woman walks SLOWLY diagonally AWAY from the viewer toward the LEFT SIDE OF THE LEFT FOREGROUND CHAIR, following the street plane to screen-left and into depth. Their back remains toward the viewer; the figure gradually becomes smaller, never approaches the camera, never enlarges toward us, never glides rigidly sideways. Use a believable human gait: alternating feet plant and support body weight, stance foot holds its ground contact while the pelvis advances, opposite heel lifts and knee bends for swing then heel/toe contacts, subtle vertical weight transfer, opposing elbow/arm swing, coat panels lag softly. Several complete slow steps during the ten seconds. Keep two separate legs and feet readable; no skating, hovering, teleportation, leg duplication or melted limbs. Move from the current start near screen x0.36 toward screen x0.12 and further away beside the left chair; preserve foreground occlusion naturally. TWO: the COLORED FILLED TILE BODIES themselves repeatedly fragment and reconstruct around their existing FIXED anchor regions. Horizontal rows split, some bands go missing, others shear sideways, pixel blocks displace and recombine; fragments can briefly stretch but the entire tile group does NOT drift or bob. Continue visible irregular local corruption throughout all ten seconds, never settle to intact static rectangles. Existing thin tracking crosses/hairlines may reconfigure subtly, but are not a substitute for actually breaking up the filled colored tiles. No full-screen flash, strobe, camera move, new buildings, scene morph, fade, new people, text or logos. This is reference for an interruptible live articulated code rig and source-sampled tile geometry, NOT a movie for runtime playback.
